title: Derived projection isomorphism for proper-support complexes
statement: Let S be Noetherian, f:X -> S locally of finite type, and E bounded with coherent cohomology and all cohomological supports proper over S. For every quasi-coherent O_S-module F there is an isomorphism Rf*E tensor^L F[0] ≅ Rf*(E tensor^L Lf*F[0]). No relative Tor condition is imposed.

source.place: Tag 08EV, support reduction and first displayed equality; Tag 08EU

proof.text: Boundedness leaves finitely many cohomological supports. Their proper union T is quasi-compact, and a quasi-compact open U contains T. The restricted map U -> S is qcqs; restriction preserves the coherent cohomology and supported-open direct-image comparison identifies Rf*E with the direct image from U. Auxiliary localizations on U are transported by localization equivalences to the fixed localizations on X and S.

Coherence on the locally Noetherian source implies quasi-coherence. Apply the quasi-coherent projection formula Tag 08EU on U. The restricted tensor input is still supported on T since E restricts to zero away from T, and restriction commutes with tensor and pullback. The supported-open comparison for that tensor input and composition comparison transport the resulting isomorphism from U to X.

theorem nonempty_properSupport_derivedProjection_iso
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
    (hcoherent : ∀ i : ℤ,
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
    (hsupport : ∀ i : ℤ,
      Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherent) :
    Nonempty (((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E) ⊗
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F ≅
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj
        (E ⊗ (derivedPullback f).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))
